headline: Two newcomers slip into the bottom of the board while DeepSeek keeps its grip on the top spot
summary: DeepSeek still leads with 28.2% of tokens, and its providers hold 38.8% overall. Mistral's mistralai/mistral-nemo and InclusionAI's ling-3.2-flash arrived at ranks 48 and 49, while x-ai/grok-4.7 fell off the board after last ranking 44th.
highlights: qwen3.8-flash-20260826 jumped 7 places to 23rd, tied for the biggest one-day climb on the board.
DeepSeek, Tencent and Zhipu AI together hold 53.8% of tokens.
x-ai/grok-4.7-20260916 dropped out after last sitting at 44th.
thinkingmachines' inkling-2-small also dropped out, last seen at 49th.
